interpretation: The real visibility gate correctly distinguished focused/active from actually visible; it must remain unchanged.
Native window occlusion or a desktop/session/surface issue is a possible browser/host hypothesis, not an established cause.
User-awake confirmation does not prove or disprove an independently recorded browser desktop/session relationship.
Shared stderr warnings cannot explain the success/failure difference on this evidence.
No basis exists to infer desktop lock, blame the user, declare a product regression, or promote the current acceptance results.
